# Tiny Good Bundle

A small hand-authored bundle exercising the features the test suite needs:

- Both absolute (SPEC §5.1) and relative (SPEC §5.2) link forms.
- Typed `relations:` frontmatter.
- Tags, a `# Schema` section with foreign-key-like text, and one concept
  intentionally missing its `description`.

## Subdirectories

* [tables](tables/index.md) - Sample table concepts.
* [references](references/index.md) - Reference / metric concepts.
